name: IPHaptics
subtitle: Haptic patterns for iPhone
description: IPHaptics plays haptic patterns on your iPhone: paint your own vibrations, feel Morse, breathe with it, or let sound drive it.

apps.name: IPHaptics
apps.subtitle: Feel your phone.
apps.localizedDescription:
Haptic patterns for iPhone, built on Core Haptics.

• Paint: draw a line, with time across and strength up, and feel it as one smooth vibration
• Eleven built-in patterns, a sequencer, and your own saved paintings
• Buzz and a continuous hum you can reshape live; a feel pad
• Breathing guide, Morse, and three games
• Shortcuts actions and Siri phrases
• Audio to haptics: bass, mids, highs or loudness from the microphone

Needs an iPhone 8 or later. iOS only lets apps vibrate while they are open on screen. Open source (MIT).

versions.localizedDescription: Shortcuts and Siri: Play Pattern, Get Patterns (build your own buttons), Play Morse, Buzz, Feel Point, Start Breathing Guide, Set Strength, Stop Haptics, Open Screen and Open Feel Pad. New iphaptics://open and iphaptics://feel links.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: IPHaptics listens to the sound around you so it can vibrate to it. Audio is analysed live and never recorded or stored.
